content: The combination of statins and fibrates has not been shown to improve atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) outcomes and is generally not recommended. Specifically, the use of statins in conjunction with gemfibrozil is strongly discouraged due to the heightened risk of rhabdomyolysis, especially in individuals with impaired renal function. Data from the ACCORD trial demonstrated no additional benefit in reducing ASCVD risk when using this combination therapy compared to statin monotherapy.
